keyInsights.title: NEPSE Broad Decline — Worst Breadth in Tracked Series: 64A vs 200D
keyInsights.body: NEPSE closed at 2660.02, down 14.45 points (-0.54%). The breadth was the most bearish in the tracked series: only 64 advances against 200 declines (1:3.1 ratio) with 10 unchanged. All sub-indices red except Finance (+0.19%) and Trading (+0.81%). Manufacturing & Processing worst at -1.10%. From Jun 10 close of 2736.17, NEPSE has lost 76.15 points over the tracked gap — a meaningful correction. Turnover increased to Rs.4.42B (vs Rs.4.30B on Jun 10) suggesting selling was active, not apathetic.
